Pilot · United States

Dennis Fitch

United Airlines Flight 2321989
Flight
United Airlines Flight 232
Date
19 July 1989
Aircraft
McDonnell Douglas DC-10
Location
Sioux City, Iowa
Survivors
184 of 296 aboard

A United training check airman travelling as a passenger, he went to the cockpit and worked the throttles to help steer the crippled DC-10 to Sioux City.

Who helped

  • Al Haynes CaptainLed the cockpit team that steered the DC-10 using engine power alone after all hydraulics failed, bringing it to Sioux City, where 184 people survived.Sources: 1 2 3 4Photo: Wayne Russell · Public domain
  • William Records First officerFlew the crippled DC-10 alongside the captain for the whole emergency, helping to steer it towards the runway at Sioux City.Sources: 1 2 3
  • Dudley Dvorak Second officer (flight engineer)Went back to inspect the damage near the tail, reported it to the cockpit, and worked through the emergency procedures with the crew.Sources: 1 2 3 4 5
  • Kevin Bachman Air traffic controller, Sioux City ApproachCalmly guided the crippled jet to Sioux City, steered it away from the city and cleared it to land on any runway while rescue crews stood by.Sources: 1 2 3
  • Jan Brown Senior flight attendantLed the cabin crew in preparing passengers for the crash landing, including brace instructions and padding for small children.Sources: 1 2 3 4
  • Jerry Schemmel PassengerAfter escaping the wreckage he heard a baby crying, went back into the plane and carried out 11-month-old Sabrina Michaelson.Sources: 1 2 3 4 5Photo: Race Across America on Flickr (Original version) 佾珜 (Crop) · CC BY 2.0
